title: A finite reduced algebra over a perfect field is etale
statement: Let k be a perfect field and A a commutative k-algebra that is finite-dimensional as a k-vector space and reduced (it has no nonzero nilpotent elements). Then A is etale over k. The zero algebra is allowed.

source.place: Tag 00U3 (lemma-etale-over-field), combined with the Artinian decomposition in Tag 00JB (lemma-artinian-finite-length) and perfectness.

proof.text: A finite-dimensional algebra over a field is Artinian. An Artinian reduced commutative ring is the product of its finitely many residue fields: the kernel of the product of quotient maps is the nilradical, hence zero, and the Chinese remainder theorem gives surjectivity. Each residue field is finite-dimensional over k as a quotient of A, so it is algebraic and separable because k is perfect. Tag 00U3 makes their finite product etale. If A is the zero algebra, the product is empty and the same conclusion holds. This is exactly the complete existing proof of Algebra.Etale.of_isReduced_of_perfectField in WeilConjectures.Mathlib.RingTheory.Etale.Field; its implementation uses IsArtinianRing.equivPi and the formally etale product criterion.
